info.title: ExhibitOS reference authentication API
info.description: Tenant-bound reference password/session adapter and metadata policy, plus full public OES rights-validated private attachment delivery (permissions.download) and export eligibility (permissions.export). Legacy flat rights are rejected, without implicit permission migration. No anonymous publication, signed object URLs or OEX byte export. Configure one exact origin. Reference HTTP listener binds only to loopback in both modes; network mode requires an external TLS terminator.

servers.description: Local loopback example; must match configured origin.
Synthetic network placeholder; replace with the exact configured HTTPS origin.

get.description: Public liveness only, not database readiness.

post.description: Requires existing credentials and tenant membership. Issues a cookie; use GET /auth/session to obtain session information and CSRF token. Login does not require a pre-existing CSRF token.

get.description: Admin or owning artist only. Full public OES rights record must pass the exported OES rights JSON schema; rights.permissions.download=true and a currently valid optional UTC validFrom/expiresAt interval are required. permissions.export and permissions.display are independent and not required here. Malformed/incomplete rights or unknown/conflicting legacy flat fields fail closed with 403 RIGHTS_DENIED. Configured private store, stored processing state, SHA-256 and byte count must match. Bounded 32 MiB attachment. Storage integrity and rights validation are not format or publication approval. No anonymous route, OEX archive or signed URL.
